setup: npm --prefix backend ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix frontend ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix agent ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix backend run db:generate && npm --prefix backend run build
run: bash scripts/e2e/down.sh && make e2e-up E2E_FAKE_GITHUB=1 E2E_FAKE_AWS=1 E2E_SPACES=1 E2E_CREDENTIAL_STORE=1 E2E_FAKE_CLAUDE=1 E2E_CLAUDE_SIGNED_IN=1 E2E_FLAGS='{"simple-ui-chrome-refresh-enabled":true,"simple-ui-reviews-enabled":true}'
seed: if [ -f scripts/e2e/scenes/review-queue.sh ]; then bash scripts/e2e/scenes/review-queue.sh; else echo 'no scripts/e2e/scenes/review-queue.sh in this checkout: the demo has the seed make e2e-up does'; fi
